title: Always Within Reach
tagline: Watch. Phone. Lock screen. A phone call. Wherever you are.
body: An electrician on a ladder. Hands holding wire. A thought fires about the next job. His phone is in his pocket. By the time he climbs down, unlocks it, opens the app, and navigates to the right screen — three minutes have passed. More likely, the thought is gone entirely. Business software was built for desks. Half the workforce doesn't have one.

surfaces.name: Lock screen
surfaces.detail: One tap starts recording. No unlock.

surfaces.name: Phone call
surfaces.detail: Dial your VOIS number. Any phone, any network.

surfaces.name: Notification
surfaces.detail: Tap a reply option without opening the app.

funnelNote: Every additional tap is a leak in the capture funnel.
quote: "If you have to open an app to use it, you've already lost."
